reporting-org.narrative: European Commission - Directorate-General for International Partnerships

title.narrative: Accelerate Prosperity in Central and South Asia (AP- ASIA)

description.narrative: The overall objective of Accelerate Prosperity (AP) ASIA is to contribute to the enhanced equitable economic well-being of women and men in rural Pakistan, Afghanistan, Tajikistan and the Kyrgyz Republic. Specifically, the Action will improve self-employment and employment of women and men in supported enterprises.

title.narrative: 2.2 Number of clients reached by supported enterprises as a result of the Action by country, type of good/service, sex, region.

description.narrative: This Indicator counts the total number of direct individuals (Customers) reached by AP supported enterprises during a reporting period. The data is directly collected from AP supported enterprises. The number of clients are reported once in reporting period. The number of clients will be selfreported by AP supported enterprises on semiannual basis. Clients refer to the customers of AP supported businesses and the forward linked businesses.The total clients can be an aggregate of AP Supported businesses and their forward linked businesses where applicable. Those businesses who do not have a forward linked businesses, only the customers of the engaged business is counted.

title.narrative: 2.1 Number of rural producers reached by supported enterprises as a result of the Action by country, type of good/service, sex, region

description.narrative: This indicator counts the number of individuals, firms, association providing input and services to the AP supported firms. Rural producers are the individual suppliers (within valuechain processes). Rural Producers can be farmers, fishers, pastoralists, ranchers, associations, firms etc or other individuals who produce goods or services. They produce supply inputs to the AP supported enterprises. Supported Enterprises: are all the businesses/economic initiatives that have received technical and/or financial assistance from the AP Asia project. The enterprises may include producers, manufacturers, traders, suppliers, and services, etc

Supported Enterprises: are all the businesses/economic initiatives that have received technical and/or financial assistance from the AP Asia project. The enterprises may include producers, manufacturers, traders, suppliers, and services, etc

title.narrative: 1.2 Amount (in EUR) of cofinancing secured by supported enterprises within three years of being supported by by country, amount, source, sex and age of owner.

description.narrative: CoFinancing refers to financing secured by supported enterprises from AP including selfcontribution. This indicator measures the total amount in Euro of the financing secured by supported organizations in three years (those who are initially supported by AP). The data will be collected through a business survey from supported businesses on an annual basis. The total volume of cofinancing secured by supported organization in Euro is reported against this indicator. SelfContribution is converted into Euro and aggregated to report against this indicator.

title.narrative: 1.1 Percentage of supported enterprises that are profitable, over the last 12 months and cumulatively over the Action by country, enterprises sector, sex and age of owner, and years supported

description.narrative: This indicator examines the profitability of supported businesses/ firms. Profitable means that the firms annual income is higher than the total annual expenses and other costs related to the business. This indicator measures the change in profitability of AP financed enterprises/businesses during a reporting period. The firms are counted when they operate more profitably in the reporting year than they did the previous reporting year. Profitability will be selfreported by Business Owners. Financially Profitableoccurs when the firms annual income is more than the annual operating expenses, including capital depreciation and amortization of permanent assets.

title.narrative: Specific Objective: Improved selfemployment and employment of women and men in supported enterprises

description.narrative: Specific Objective: Improved selfemployment and employment of women and men in supported enterprisesImproved selfemployment and employment of women and men in supported enterprises

title.narrative: 1. Number of full and part time jobs created and sustained in supported enterprise by country, sector, gender, age, province/region, and employment status.

description.narrative: This indicator counts the total number of FullTime Equivalent jobs created and sustained as a result of AP interventions over the project life. The indicator will be used to track the change in the number of net FTE jobs in supported enterprises since the onset of the project. Jobs are all types of employment opportunities (fulltime/parttime/seasonal or short term) that may also include selfemployment. Fulltime equivalent (FTE) job refers to regular employment of at least for one calendar year. One FTE job equals 8 hours per day x 260 days per year 2080 hours per year ).Parttime job: equals 130 days (6 months of work per calendar year) Parttime jobs are converted to fulltime equivalent jobs on a prorata basis, based on definition (e.g., if working week equals 40 hours, a 20 hour/week job for a calendar year would be equal to 0.5 FTE jobSeasonal or short terms jobs are temporary jobs for less than three months (65 days) in a calendar year. Seasonal or shortterm jobs are prorated based on the portion of the reporting period that was worked (e.g., a fulltime position for three months would be equal to a 0.25 FTE job if the reporting period is one year).If the information is not available, the rule of thumb is two parttime jobs equal a fulltime job.Selfemployment: refers to the state of working for oneself rather than as an employer/owner of the business. New Job: A new job created refers to one FullTime Equivalent job resulting from AP interventions. Sustained Job: A job is sustained when an existing job/employment survives and/or maintains as a result of the technical and financial support provided by AP Asia for at least one calendar year.

comment.narrative: The total youth Jobs are 942.
